problem_statement: When iterating over NAT64 address mappings, the remaining expiration time (mRemainingTimeMs) reported for each entry is not consistent because it is computed relative to the time each entry is individually accessed rather than relative to a single initialization point. The address mapping iterator should support a class-based API where it is initialized once (capturing a common time origin) and then advanced entry-by-entry, so that all remaining-time values share the same reference point regardless of when or how fast each entry is fetched.
